relations.evidence: gajiṃdrale paṭanākā budhasiṃbhaiyākā pustakabāṭa sāriliyāko ho

date.as_written: śrīśāke 1720 samvat 1855 nepālasamvat 918 sāla śrāvanādhikaśukla 11 somavāsare, anurādhānakṣatre brahmayoge

notes: The colophon is in Nepali: 'gajiṃdrale paṭanākā budhasiṃbhaiyākā pustakabāṭa sāriliyāko ho' ('Gajīndra copied [this] from the book of Budhasiṃhabhaiyā of Paṭanā'). Budhasiṃha was the owner of the exemplar rather than the donor of the current manuscript.
